text_block_list.text:
—On what should have been a peaceful, 
gentle New Year's morning...
That news came out of the blue...!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“――Entering the 'Age of the Strongest'!? 
The legendary Umamusume rise to the 
challenge!”

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news! The renowned Umamusume who 
recently caused a stir by returning to 
race after a long hiatus have just held a 
press conference."

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"All of them have announced their entry 
into this year's GⅠ campaigns, and—"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"They are all powerhouses who have 
achieved great feats—"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki-san! What was your intention 
behind declaring your entry into a GⅠ at 
this timing?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, it's hard to explain, but... —To 
become a wall, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "...Pardon?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"We run so that we can be a great wall for 
our juniors. Surely, that's why."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I eagerly await your challenge."

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“—This marks the true beginning of the era 
of the strongest! We can expect this 
year's races to become even more fiercely 
contested!”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ... A wall...

After watching the shocking news together, 
Eishin Flash was visibly shaken.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No way... It can't be. For something like 
this to—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...You expect me to face people of that 
caliber all over again...?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...That's correct. And up until now, the 
results have spoken for themselves."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I know what they're capable of. 
Whether we can overcome this next wall 
remains to be seen..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The races will surely become fiercer. Our 
win rate will drop..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Which means—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will show you how much I’ve grown.’ 
...That is the promise I just made to my 
parents."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is there a chance... we won't be able to 
fulfill our promise?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"A little"? Just how much is "a little" to 
you...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Calm down... what does that mean? Am I 
not staying still right now...?"

Eishin Flash is in utter shock and has 
fallen into a negative spiral. Perhaps 
what she needs right now is a change of 
pace.

And so, I brought her for the first shrine 
visit of the year, but—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that news?! This year's 
race is gonna be insane!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Right? It's definitely gonna be a 
spectacle. Though I kinda feel bad for 
them too.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're saying I gotta face off 
against the girls who just moved up from 
the Classic Class this year, right?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, seriously. That's so sad...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean... by "something 
different"?

Eishin Flash had shown a strong interest 
in Japanese culture before. I hoped doing 
this would change her mood for the better 
once again...
choice_data_list: Let's just laze around for New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that really something one needs to 
go out of their way to psych themselves up 
for?"
choice_data_list:
What's important is making a decision and 
following through!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...You may have a point. It all comes 
down to one's own will, after all."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san recommended it to me before. 
Let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much, Trainer. Even a 
15-minute nap helps relieve fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I had a wonderful dream too. A bird 
named Mambo-kun was flying toward Mt. 
Fuji—

After taking a nap in the trainer's 
office, Eishin Flash seemed to have slept 
well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I know what it is. It's an 'ema' plaque, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been interested for a 
while, but since it only happens once a 
year, the opportunity never arose.
choice_data_list: All the more reason to do it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I believe there was a corner over 
that way—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—I wrote: 'May I carry out my schedule to 
absolute perfection.'"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is my creed. What did you write down, 
Trainer?

I showed her an ema charm that read: "May 
Eishin Flash perfectly execute her 
schedule without overworking herself."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You beat me to it, didn't you? As 
expected of you, Trainer.

Eishin Flash finally let out a gentle 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Starting now? In Japan, it's customary 
to have them delivered right as the new 
year begins, isn't that right?"
choice_data_list:
It just kinda turned into this while I was 
making my New Year's rounds.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying that doing so directly on 
New Year's Day is not a breach of 
etiquette either?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will prepare it 
immediately.

And so, we bought New Year's cards, wrote 
them on the spot, and exchanged them, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I'm actually quite good 
at sketching copies.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanted a chance to show you, 
Trainer... So this is perfect."

The New Year's card she handed me with a 
proud look featured a realistic drawing of 
a ladybug, accompanied by the Japanese 
message, "Good luck to you."
